description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Cost 2 charges of Ghost-Static

Area 10-foot burst within 60 feet

Saving Throw Fortitude

Small area effect that disables or staggers constructs and machines.

Every construct and machine in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure it is slowed 1 for 1 round; on a critical failure it is stunned 1 and cannot use reactions for 1 round. Creatures that are neither constructs nor machines are unaffected, as is any device that is not currently running.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 (activated AoE save action) -- [NO-SPECIALRESOURCE] for the 2-Ghost-Static cost. Also no clean way to gate an automated save-and-branch condition application to "constructs and machines only" via a static predicate; this is the shape of a full spell-like effect, which real pf2e always builds via spellcasting infrastructure, never via a bare feat's system.rules.
